editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam consists of 90 questions to be completed in 150 minutes. Ensure you arrive at the testing center or log into the remote proctoring platform early. Read all instructions carefully, as some questions are scenario-based or require selecting multiple correct responses.

faq.answer_text: The CIPP/A exam contains 90 multiple-choice questions. Some of these are scenario-based, and others may require you to select a specific number of correct responses from the provided options to demonstrate your understanding of the material.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The passing score for the exam is 300 out of 500. This score is determined by psychometric analysis to ensure that the exam maintains a consistent standard of difficulty for all candidates who take the test.
You have 150 minutes to complete the 90 questions on the CIPP/A exam. Plan your time accordingly to ensure you can address all sections of the test effectively within the allotted duration.

If you require information regarding the long-term certification path or career progression, please check with IAPP for the current certification path and requirements to ensure you remain aligned with their standards and professional development goals.
faq.question_title: What is the certification path if I need further guidance?

editorial.meta_description: The CIPP/A certification from the IAPP covers privacy laws and data protection practices across Asian economies, including Singapore, Hong Kong, and India.

methodology.summary: This index was compiled by reviewing official IAPP exam documentation, candidate handbooks, and verified third-party study guides to ensure all information aligns with current certification standards and industry best practices for privacy professionals.

editorial.overview: The Certified Information Privacy Professional/Asia (CIPP/A) is a professional credential offered by the IAPP. It covers privacy laws, data protection regulations, and information management practices specific to various Asian jurisdictions. The exam evaluates knowledge of privacy frameworks and regional legal requirements, helping professionals guide enterprises through complex data protection environments in Asia and globally. This certification validates expertise in navigating the diverse regulatory landscape that defines modern privacy operations for organizations operating within these specific regional markets.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Utilize the official body of knowledge and exam blueprint to guide your review. Access free IAPP study guides and consider practice exams to simulate the testing experience. While training courses are available, they are not a substitute for independent study of the core privacy topics. Ensure you review all regional legal requirements to prepare for the 90 questions found on the exam. Consistent review of the official documentation is a standard practice for success in this field.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is for professionals in legal, compliance, information management, data governance, or human resources roles. It is suitable for those responsible for implementing privacy operations and managing data protection standards within organizations operating in Asian markets.
